```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Results
df <- data.frame(size = c(0.21, 0.21, 0.21, 0.21, 56, 56, 56, 56, 272, 272, 272, 272),
           threads = c(4,3,2,1,4,3,2,1,4,3,2,1),
           seconds = c(180,175,163,250,212,224,240,320,320,334,552,1224))
```

```{r}
cols <- rainbow(length(unique(df$threads)))[as.factor(df$threads)]

plot(df$size, df$seconds,
     col = cols,
     pch = 19,
     xlab = "Problem Size (MB)",
     ylab = "Seconds")

legend("topleft",
       legend = levels(as.factor(df$threads)),
       col = rainbow(length(unique(df$threads))),
       pch = 19,
       title = "Threads")

```
